mapper.sql: n.id, n.title, n.body, n.level, n.pinned, n.active, n.starts_at, n.ends_at, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.name AS creator_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_dismissals d WHERE d.notice_id = n.id) AS dismiss_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notices n LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = n.created_by ORDER BY n.active DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT FROM notices n LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = n.created_by WHERE n.active = TRUE AND (n.starts_at IS NULL OR n.starts_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (n.ends_at IS NULL OR n.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (n.pinned = TRUE OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_dismissals d WHERE d.notice_id = n.id AND d.admin_id = #{adminId})) ORDER BY CASE n.level WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, n.pinned DESC, n.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (title, body, level, pinned, active, starts_at, ends_at, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{body}, #{level}, #{pinned}, #{active}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, level = #{level}, pinned = #{pinned}, active = #{active}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notices SET active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notice_dismissals WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND admin_id = #{adminId}
